label: The nine's immanent operation derived from intellect as a capacity exercised by a pure act
summary: Follow-up to attempt 38c1e7b1 (PR #1479). Question: can the bare premise 8f93d9cc (NineOperate: whatever has the nine has an immanent operation, Operates of definition 7acc985a) be derived from commitments that do not nearly restate 'lives'? Result (specs/dei-filius-operation-from-intellect.toml, TruthCore/Causality/DeiFiliusOperationFromIntellect.lean, zero axioms): yes, from three open analyst premises: (1) 9c2a5dfe, whatever has intellect has the capacity to understand (CapacityPotency CanBe x understanding; POTENCY_3, DEF-CAPACITY-TO-BE; the respect of understanding is the new primitive definition 39f50105); (2) 4728d5f4, whatever has that capacity is actually understanding or in potency to understanding (same InAct and InPotency as the nine; restricted to the one respect); (3) 021aaa19, whatever has the capacity to understand and actually understands has an immanent operation (q.18 a.3 ad 1, no claim on file). Proof: a being with the nine has intellect (eighth) and is pure act (sixth, altogether immutability), so the potency branch of (2) is excluded and the exercise branch with (3) gives Operates (nineOperateFromCapacity, result 524a763b; constructive disjunction elimination). The intellect-restricted middle version 29d1f5f5 (every pure act with intellect operates) is derived from the same three (c55e2ce2) and registered in the strength order between STMT-PURE-ACT-OPERATES (45030701) and 8f93d9cc (relations backed by 86ee4407 and f7bc7a96; strictness by controls 5785fe99 parts 6-7). Controls: one omission model per premise, each with a being that has the nine and does not operate; nonvacuity; and the nonvacuity model has the being with the nine operating while neither LIVING_1 nor LIVING_2, so the derivation does not carry life back in (the earlier P1 concern). PREMISE COMPARISON (computed frontier-diff against origin/main c220157db): one verified support alternative added (8f93d9cc from the three); 8f93d9cc moves bare -> closed; three bare premises added; open premises reaching the root 446 -> 448. Note: the strength-order backing result alone (f7bc7a96, from 29d1f5f5) does not close 8f93d9cc by frontier rule, hence the direct composition 524a763b. WHERE THE WEIGHT NOW RESTS: (1) is close to the meaning of HAS_INTELLECT_1; (3) is a classification on the formal reading of InAct (7acc985a already lists understanding as an immanent operation), but InAct is the nine's shared predicate, read formally or virtually (DEF-UNIVERSALLY-PERFECT), and the capacity condition does not exclude virtual act, so on the inclusive reading (3) also carries the explicit open bridge that capable virtual act of understanding is an immanent operation (Codex review P1 on PR #1481; recorded in the statement, definition 39f50105 and module doc, not supplied by the capacity guard); (2) carries the act/potency content, and under the adopted sense of potency (AdoptedPotency.InPotency: capable and not actually) it is excluded middle for actually understanding at a capable being (exercisedOrInPotencyOfDecidable in the Solution, unregistered); classically it is the right-to-left direction of the Metaphysics IX.6 analysis (STMT-POTENCY-IS-UNACTUALIZED-CAPACITY) at one respect, but no argument from that statement is registered since it would need excluded middle (zero-axiom policy). So the operation step of the living conjunct now rests on the nine's intellect and pure act (derived elsewhere on the spine) plus the IX.6 capacity analysis at one respect, not on a near-restatement of living. RESTRICTION REASON: the general (every-respect) version of (2) would make a pure act exercise every capacity, including any power to produce an effect it does not produce; the classical position (ST I q.25 a.5, attribution deferred) denies that this puts an agent in potency; that targets the general version only. OBJECTION AUDIT (substantive objection standard): timeless agency (understanding requires succession) targets neither the inference nor (1)-(3) as stated (none is time-indexed) but the joint satisfiability of intellect with pure act: if actual understanding always involves potency to a further thought, (1)+(2) make every intellectual being understand and no pure act could have intellect, so the nine would be unsatisfiable and the route vacuous. No independent justification for the succession mechanism is on file (Pike, God and Timelessness; Swinburne, The Coherence of Theism; Lucas: unread leads, no weight). Divine intellect not a faculty distinct from its act (q.14 a.4): does not target (1), since CanBe requires no distinct faculty and holds of whatever actually understands. No substantive objection to the restricted premises identified. Attribution deferred throughout; no claim states any new premise; no premise is established.
blocker: Not blocked. Next tests: a perfection route (IsPerfect: some being actually understands, so a universally perfect being is in act in understanding) needs the formal rather than eminent sense for premise (3) and belongs with the perfection-transfer lane; a time-indexed understanding respect under which the succession question could be posed and tested against the nine (the open obligation of 7acc985a); a typed LIVING_1 under which the sense bridge could be derived or fail.
